subject: [PATCH 2/3] btrfs: fix barrier usage in btrfs_record_root_in_trans()

reviews.author: Filipe Manana
reviews.summary: Reviewer disputed the claim that using READ/WRITE_ONCE prevents instruction reordering, pointing out it only addresses compiler-level reordering, load/store tearing, and other issues
reviews.raw_body:
I'm not sure what you mean. If you are mentioning the helpers for
last_trans use READ/WRITE_ONCE and that that prevents the bug being
fixed here, then that is not correct, because READ/WRITE_ONCE does not
prevent a CPU from reordering intructions (just compiler level
reordering, load/store tearing and a few other things).

reviews.author: Boris Burkov (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that using smp_store_release/smp_load_acquire would have prevented the bug and agreed to document why they are not being used.
reviews.raw_body:
Sorry for being unclear. No, what I mean is I think we should
justify/document why we are not using smp_store_release/smp_load_acquire
since those are exactly this pattern, and if we had used them, it would
have prevented the bug.

reviews.author: Filipe Manana
reviews.summary: Reviewer questioned the choice of using smp_wmb/smp_rmb instead of smp_store_release/smp_load_acquire, suggesting that the latter would have prevented the bug and are easier to read.
reviews.raw_body:
It should work, but I don't see an advantage of one method over the
other (perhaps smp_store_release and and_load_acquire are a bit easier
to read for some).

I have no idea why that code (really old now) was written using smp_wmb/rmb.
Perhaps the macros for smp_store_release and and_load_acquire did not
exist back then, and that explains why we don't use them anywhere in
btrfs and always use smp_wmb/rmb.

reviews.author: Boris Burkov (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that using smp_store_release/smp_load_acquire would have prevented the bug and agreed to remove the additional justification/explanation.
sentiment_signals: acknowledged a fix is not needed
reviews.raw_body:
OK, all good. Thanks for the discussion and the fix, and you don't need
to bother with any additional justification or explanation.

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes a barrier usage issue in btrfs_record_root_in_trans() by justifying why smp_store_release/smp_load_acquire are not used, which would have prevented the bug.
